_about: goBILDA 5203 Yellow Jacket variants. All are the same bare motor behind a gearbox, so the bare numbers are the single origin and every variant is derived from its ratio. That keeps the table self-consistent: freeRpm x ratio = 5955..5994 for every listed variant, which is the 6000 RPM bare motor.

bare._source: goBILDA 5203 datasheet (312 RPM variant: 24.3 kg.cm / 19.2 = 1.266 kg.cm bare); rotorInertia is a guess

variants_source: goBILDA product pages; ticksPerRev as published (they differ from 28 x ratio by <1%)
